title: Mike McMahon
description: An especially abstract interpretation of a stormtrooper. "They're super-nasty in just about any style," comments Mike McMahon. McMahon was born in 1953, the year of Cinemascope and 3D movies, in St. Albans, England. He was inspired by comics, picture books and (especially) epic/action films. 'I remember being particularly excited by KING OF KINGS with Jeffrey Hunter," the artist explains. "l liked it when the Romans killed all the zealots in the fort." In 1976, McMahon did his first professional work; later that year he started drawing JUDGE DREDD for IPC Magazines. "I've been working ever since," he adds.
